connector.name: Cloudcraft MCP
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial MCP server for reading and managing Cloudcraft architecture blueprints
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cloudcraft-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hypark5540 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLOUDCRAFT_API_KEY
env.description: Cloudcraft API key with access to the target account

env.name: CLOUDCRAFT_BASE_URL
env.description: Cloudcraft API base URL; HTTPS is required except for loopback testing

env.description: Minimum log level written to stderr

env.name: CLOUDCRAFT_EXPORT_DIR
env.description: Directory under which exported blueprint files may be written

env.name: CLOUDCRAFT_ENABLE_WRITES
env.description: Enable create and update operations

env.name: CLOUDCRAFT_ENABLE_DELETES
env.description: Enable irreversible deletes; writes must also be enabled

env.name: CLOUDCRAFT_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
env.description: Maximum bytes accepted from one Cloudcraft API response
